system.notes:
Ancient aboleth that learned the art of shapeshifting and walks amongst mortals.

AC 16, HP 39, ATK 2 tentacle (near) +5 (1d8 + curse) or 1 tail +5 (3d6) or mucus cloud, MV near (swim), S +4, D -1, C +3, I +4, W +2, Ch +2, AL C, LV 8

Curse. CON 15+ or target gains a magical curse, turning into a deep one over 2d10 days.

Enslave. In place of attacks, one creature within far. WIS 15+ or aboleth controls for 1d4 rounds.

Mucus Cloud. Emit a near- sized mucus cloud centered on master. CON 15+ or target gains a magical curse, turning into a deep one over 2d10 days.

Shapechange. Assume the form of a humanoid.

Telepathic. Read the thoughts of all creatures within far.
